# Chess Desktop

> Chess Desktop is a free, open-source desktop client for Chess.com and Lichess, available for Windows and Linux.

Chess Desktop is an independent project and is not affiliated with Chess.com or Lichess.

## Product

- [Website](https://chessdesktop.app/): Product overview, features, frequently asked questions, and downloads.
- [Latest release](https://github.com/vocaldll/chess-desktop/releases/latest): Current Windows and Linux downloads.

## Project

- [Source and documentation](https://github.com/vocaldll/chess-desktop): Source code, installation instructions, and feature documentation.
- [Privacy](https://github.com/vocaldll/chess-desktop/blob/master/PRIVACY.md): Crash-reporting and data-handling details.
- [Issue tracker](https://github.com/vocaldll/chess-desktop/issues): Bug reports, feature requests, and support.
- [License](https://github.com/vocaldll/chess-desktop/blob/master/LICENSE): MIT License.
